name: 移速修改
author: Cabbird
description: Scales the per-frame speed multiplier the game already computes (AliveProperty.get_SpeedReviseRatio, GameAssembly.dll+0x18052A0) on the way out; nothing in game state is written. A capture hook on PlayerEntityManageSystem.UpdateControllingGameObject remembers the controlled entity via the host's read_memory, so monsters are not accelerated. Both targets are prologue-checked; a mismatched build is refused, not hooked.
